map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于维护验收: Report usability: all three must pass before maintenance acceptance
map.逐项判定：浓度 3~8%、PH 8~10、防锈等级≤1 级；三项均满足为合格。浓: Item-by-item: concentration 3~8%, pH 8~10, rust-protection class ≤ 1; all three satisfied = pass. Low concentration gives poor lubrication; low pH easily spoils and rusts.
map.浓度 5%（区间✓）、PH 9（区间✓）、防锈等级 1 级（≤1 ✓）：三项全合: Concentration 5% (range ✓), pH 9 (range ✓), rust class 1 (≤1 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If pH drops to 7 it fails, spoilage and rust risk rise.
map.碱性抑制细菌繁殖并提升防锈；过低（趋中性/酸）易腐败、伤机床，须补加杀菌/防锈剂: Alkalinity inhibits bacterial growth and improves rust protection; too low (near neutral/acidic) spoils easily and damages the machine, so add biocide/rust inhibitor to restore.
map.为铸铁屑法等的防锈评级，1 级最优（无明显锈）；≥2 级表示防锈不足，须调整配方: It is a rust rating such as the cast-iron chip method; class 1 is best (no obvious rust); ≥2 means insufficient protection, so adjust formula or concentration.
map.切削液浓度过低影响防锈和润滑效果: Too-low cutting-fluid concentration impairs rust protection and lubrication
map.PH值偏酸会加剧腐蚀，偏碱影响皮肤: Acidic pH accelerates corrosion; strongly alkaline affects skin
